templatesHelp.title: Template Variables
templatesHelp.body:
Templates let you control how account details are generated during registration. Use Go template syntax with double curly braces, e.g. {'{'}{'{'}.VARIABLE_NAME{'}'}{'}'}.

Identifiers:
  {'{'}{'{'}.ACCOUNT_ID{'}'}{'}'}  - unique numeric account identifier
  {'{'}{'{'}.RANDOM_NONSENSE{'}'}{'}'}  - 8 random characters (at least 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 digit, 1 special)

Name fields:
  {'{'}{'{'}.FIRST_NAME{'}'}{'}'},  {'{'}{'{'}.LAST_NAME{'}'}{'}'}  - randomly generated names
  {'{'}{'{'}.LC_FIRST_NAME{'}'}{'}'},  {'{'}{'{'}.LC_LAST_NAME{'}'}{'}'}  - lowercase versions
  {'{'}{'{'}.FULL_NAME{'}'}{'}'}  - first + last name
  {'{'}{'{'}.LC_FULL_NAME{'}'}{'}'}  - lowercase full name

Faker data:
  {'{'}{'{'}.USERNAME{'}'}{'}'}  - lowercase first initial + last name + random number
  {'{'}{'{'}.COMPANY{'}'}{'}'}  - random company name
  {'{'}{'{'}.CITY{'}'}{'}'},  {'{'}{'{'}.COUNTRY{'}'}{'}'}  - random location
  {'{'}{'{'}.JOB_TITLE{'}'}{'}'},  {'{'}{'{'}.BUZZWORD{'}'}{'}'}  - random job title / buzzword
  {'{'}{'{'}.DOMAIN{'}'}{'}'}  - random domain name

Digit helpers:
  {'{'}{'{'}.DIGITS_1{'}'}{'}'}  through  {'{'}{'{'}.DIGITS_6{'}'}{'}'}  - zero-padded random numbers with 1-6 digits

You can combine multiple variables freely, for example:
  {'{'}{'{'}.LC_FIRST_NAME{'}'}{'}'}. {'{'}{'{'}.LC_LAST_NAME{'}'}{'}'} {'{'}{'{'}.DIGITS_2{'}'}{'}'} {'@'}yourdomain.com

customQueriesHelp.title: Custom Query Templates
customQueriesHelp.body:
Add custom search queries to include in scraping runs. Enter one query per line.

You can use template placeholders that expand into multiple queries:

  {'{'}{'{'} ALL_COUNTRIES {'}'}{'}'} - generates one query for every available country
  {'{'}{'{'} CONTINENT:Name {'}'}{'}'} - generates one query for each country on the named continent

Available continents:
  Europe, Asia, North America, South America, Africa, Oceania, Middle East

Example:
  host.services.vnc.security_types.value:"1" and host.location.country:"{'{'}{'{'} ALL_COUNTRIES {'}'}{'}'} "

This single line would expand into ~97 queries, one per country.

  host.services.rdp and host.location.country:"{'{'}{'{'} CONTINENT:Europe {'}'}{'}'} "

This would expand into one query per European country.
